content.summary: An adult dancer turns four poses into a 10K thank-you card. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult performer and one circular frame remain anchors. + Each graphic appears after a visible pose. + Text is exact, short and readable. + Frame motion follows body motion without hiding it. + The final card reunites milestone, gratitude and performer.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one clearly adult shadow performer inside a cyan circular light frame on a charcoal stage. A side lean tilts the frame by thirty degrees while the performer remains centered. Return the frame upright and hold the performer beneath the exact final line THANK YOU / STILL MAKING.
